senses.gloss: (b. h.) to be compressed, dark, hidden (cmp. אטם, טמא, טמן).

units: R. Hash. 18ᵃ; Yeb. 105ᵃ (ref. to Jer. II, 22) taken as equivalent with נחתם.—Part. Pu. מְכוּתָּם stained.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 16">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVI</cite> (play on <cite ref="M01454"><he>מכתם</he></cite>) David said to the Lord <he>מכ׳ אני</he> ed. Bub. (oth. ed. <cite ref="M01454"><he>מכתם</he></cite>, corr. acc.) I am stained (with sin).
